maps.name: Drop-Off
maps.description: An industrial rooftop arena with control rooms, elevated platforms and working ziplines.
maps.notes: The sun now comes from Apex's direction: Drop-Off had been lit with Phase Runner's sun, from nearly the opposite side, so its baked sun shadows, sun shading and character lighting are re-baked for Apex's sun. Reflection cubemaps captured in game give metal, glass and wet surfaces something to reflect, and the sun-shadow geometry is welded, so the map file is about 25 MB smaller. Tested on Northstar 1.31.14 in single-client PS/FFA: all 60 spawns clear and supported, both teams, weapon fire, postmatch lobby and stock/map reload; this is not multiplayer certification. Requires ApexMaps.UI 0.2.1.

maps.name: Phase Runner
maps.description: Snow, rock and industrial tunnels connect opposing bases beneath the phase machinery.
maps.notes: The control-room consoles in both bases are drawn from the full Apex mesh with lighting taken from their own surface, so their panels no longer look stretched or streaky. Includes 1.7.1: flicker-free base floors, container frames, smooth catwalks, and 1.7.0 blending, ground tiling and rock collision.

maps.name: Thermal Station
maps.description: World's Edge's geothermal station and its lava fields, cut out of the battle royale map as a pilot arena.
maps.notes: Converted from current Apex. The arena is cut from the full World's Edge map with its own collision, lighting and storm sky. The 4,628 Apex placements the world budget left out, mostly grass and plants, are native props with baked shadows; solid ones collide and larger ones cast real-time sun shadows. Reflection cubemaps are captured in game. There is no R5Reloaded source for this version of the map, so the gallery shows the port only.

maps.name: Thunderdome
maps.description: Fuse's floating arena: wetlands, treehouses and the giant skull, ringed by a stadium crowd.
maps.notes: Converted from current Apex. Over 6,700 Apex props are compiled as native static props with collision, foliage and re-baked shadows; 3,344 of them cast real-time sun shadows, and reflection cubemaps captured in game light metal and wet surfaces. Small clutter fades with distance. Apex's runtime UI screens around the stadium cannot be reproduced and show their static backing. There is no R5Reloaded source for this map, so the gallery shows the port only.
